errors.ambiguous_id: More than one item has the requested id.

errors.fetch_blocked: The destination is outside the public address space.
errors.fetch_failed: The resource or model download failed.
errors.invalid: A value, link or destination was refused.

errors.io: The command could not complete an operation.
errors.no_content: The input has no usable content.
errors.no_model: Semantic indexing is disabled in this brain.
errors.not_found: The item or input file does not exist in the call's view.
errors.personal_exposed: The personal section could be exposed in Git.
errors.personal_unavailable: The personal section cannot be reached.
errors.too_large: The input or produced file exceeds its size limit.
errors.unsupported_edit: The existing item cannot be edited in place.
errors.unsupported_type: The input's format or encoding is unsupported.

notices.after_write: The write was published and a later operation failed.
notices.cpu_fallback: Sync is embedding on the CPU.

notices.destination: The section where the write will land.
notices.embedding_device: Sync is embedding on the named accelerator.
notices.git_history: A shared deletion leaves old versions in Git history.
notices.secret_suspected: Input text matches a possible secret pattern.
notices.semantic_partial: Some items lack semantic index coverage.
notices.skipped_files: Some broken item files were skipped.
notices.undeclared_tag: The item uses a tag without a declaration.
